plain_english_policy: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment specifically for Cullman County. Its primary effect is to transition the county's sheriff and revenue commissioner from a 'supernumerary' employment status (which typically allows officials to hold office without being subject to standard civil service retirement rules) into the state-wide Employees' Retirement System.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would legally prohibit Cullman County sheriffs or revenue commissioners from assuming new supernumerary offices after the amendment takes effect. It grants current eligible officials in those roles the option to continue their existing benefits while simultaneously allowing them (and future hires) to join the standard Employees' Retirement System, including eligibility for service credit purchase upon ratification.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a measure that alters retirement system participation rules specifically for Cullman County officials.
evidence_quotes: "No Cullman County sheriff or revenue commissioner may assume a supernumerary office after the effective date of this amendment."

"The Cullman County sheriff and revenue commissioner may participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama upon the same terms and conditions as may be specified by law for any other employee in the same retirement system."
